Around the world, football fans are fighting over one question. Who is the GOAT? Kaito or Ren? It's like East versus West. Fire versus water. They're both great in their own ways.
Kaito is strong. He built himself into a goal-scoring machine. Give him a little space and he's already past you. Then comes the shot. That's Kaito. Speed and power.

On the other side, there's Ren. He stays calm. He was born with a special skill. Watch how close he keeps the ball. One little touch and the first defender is gone. Another change of direction and he's straight through to goal. Nobody can stop him. That's Ren's dribbling.
They're the perfect example of great rivals. Two different ways to be great at the same game. But the fans are still fighting over who's best. One side says Kaito. The other side says Ren.
In the end... only legends know. Barry Bunce.
